title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Huang Behavior Complaints
title_cn: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Huang Behavior Complaints
summary:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy.
Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF

About two decades ago, two Nvidia employees complained about how then-Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang treated his staff. Stephen Pettigrew, the first in-house lawyer hired by Nvidia, said he observed Huang regularly verbally abusing and intimidating employees, according to court documents filed in the Superior Court of California. Pettigrew alleged he was fired for raising concerns about the conduct of Nvidia executives, while the company cited performance issues for his termination, according to court documents.

Ian King, Bloomberg News US Semiconductor Reporter
Mark Gurman, Bloomberg News Managing Editor of Consumer Technology
Anna Wong, Bloomberg Economics Chief US Economist
Michael Ball, Bloomberg News Macro Strategist  (Source: Bloomberg)
